description: This PHP source file defines the AdminChartsApiController class, which provides API endpoints for generating various statistical and analytical data related to investments, projects, and financial metrics within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for aggregating data over time slots, filtering by different parameters, and computing totals for investments and projects, with a focus on admin-level access and detailed financial reporting.

classes.name: AdminChartsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for admin-level statistical data related to investments and projects, including aggregations, totals, and time-based reports.

methods.name: getAggregatesSQLFilter
methods.description: Constructs SQL filter conditions and values based on request query parameters for filtering investment or project data.

methods.name: aggregatesAction
methods.description: Generates aggregated investment or project data over time, grouped by specified time slots, with filtering options.

methods.name: timeSlots
methods.description: Defines various preset time slots (e.g., today, yesterday, week, month, year) for data filtering, with support for custom ranges.

methods.name: totalInvestsAction
methods.description: Calculates total investment metrics for different targets (raised, active, refunded, etc.) over specified time slots and filters.

methods.name: totalProjectsAction
methods.description: Provides totals and summaries for projects over different statuses and time periods, including pending projects.
